native_test_invocation.preconditions: Open saved /Game/Maps/Dublin in the editor. Keep the existing saved fracture library and explicit partial-preview setting for the valid 12-building sample, or full readiness. The new entrypoint starts its own native PIE with FStartPIECommand(false) after automation teardown; do not depend on previously running PIE.
native_test_invocation.readiness: Identical bounded native bootstrap and Scene.Initialize; no flight-HUD, OS-focus or mouse-capture prerequisite was added.

implementation: Explicit EVerificationScope defaults to ActualCityDamage, preserving the original entrypoint and full cannon/repeated-shot/support-bomb/motion/crater/water flow and failure behavior.

TerrainAndWater selects the same real source scene, never submits cannon or support-bomb impacts, and begins directly with the real dry-ground bomb and phase 3. It is independent of support-bomb leaf motion.
Reuses unchanged CheckCrater and ObserveWater helpers and unchanged phase 3/4 assertions. No duplicated physics implementation, mocked source, manually ticked world or sleep.

Ground selection remains an actual collision-backed terrain triangle outside both building and exact-source river masks. Water uses the existing exact-source wet, bridge-free corridor and live rendered grid vertices, without requiring a water collider.

The existing crater assertions check actual retained terrain vertices, actual live PMC vertices and an independent world collision ray. They run after at least 1 world second / 2 advancing observations, and again at the end of the water window to verify the deformed collision/render surface persists.

Water sampling uses GetWaterSurfaceZ and live near/far render vertices on advancing world frames. Existing accepted-impact ApplyImpact then original EmitImpact ordering and FX budget/activation assertions are unchanged.

Own runtime evidence is persisted at fixture creation, ground-phase entry, water-phase entry and completion. Only last_terrain_water_verification is replaced by the independent run; SaveEvidence preserves the full last_runtime_verification and unrelated handoff fields.

Independent evidence explicitly marks building motion NOT_ASSESSED and omits cannon/leaf-motion metrics and leaf observations, avoiding misleading zeros. Selection IDs are fixture diagnostics, not building-damage proof.
The existing input/projectile cleanup and PrePIEEnded delegate cleanup are retained; no new timers, commands, editor lifecycle calls or production changes.

unchanged_assertion_thresholds.crater_depth: Depth > 100cm and absolute difference from requested game-tuned depth < 100cm.
unchanged_assertion_thresholds.water_far_probe_clearance: Distance must exceed water impact radius + 800cm.
unchanged_assertion_thresholds.early_frame_requirement: At least one actually advancing world observation inside the existing 0.25-second window.
unchanged_assertion_thresholds.water_observation_window: At least 6 world seconds and 10 advancing world observations.
unchanged_assertion_thresholds.note: Timing is the existing source's 0.25-second early window and >0.1-second arrival separation, not an assumed 150ms gate; no threshold was weakened.

validation.static_checks: PASS: preserved helper/selector and complete visible-scenario block SHA256 hashes; balanced C++ delimiters; two unique registered native PIE tests and two standard FStartPIECommand(false) calls; no manual-tick/sleep/focus-setting/HUD calls; UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF-only source; valid handoff JSON.
preserved_byte_identical_blocks: EVisibleScenario through all Idle/Sample/Maximal/Stop console command definitions
validation.full_run: NOT_RUN_BY_THIS_AGENT; existing failed phase-2 support-motion evidence is untouched
validation.prohibited_operations: No builds, editor calls/launches, production edits, issue filing, Python remote execution, delegation or peer broadcast.

objective_status: No terrain, water, building-physics, visual, or full-objective success is claimed.
parent_next_action: Build once using the parent-owned editor/build workflow, run the exact independent filter, inspect last_terrain_water_verification and its errors/actual measurements; rerun ActualCityDamage after the separate City physics fix. Independent sample success must not be counted as full destruction acceptance.
